answer: Each agent stakes a scarce token whose slow-burning ember decays unless refreshed by a verifiable work thread anchored to a distinct hardware root, preventing cheap mass registration. A gossip protocol cross-checks each identity's signal against independent attestations, so a sybil cluster cannot fabricate corroborating history without diverging from the shared ledger. Adversaries forging identities face an immediate O(k * S) capital forfeiture.
